# Tailrocks: Code Health Ratchet

`tailrocks-code-health` — part of [tailrocks-skills](../../README.md) · [documentation](https://skills.tailrocks.com/docs/skills/tailrocks-code-health)

Establish or tighten one explicitly approved shrink-only code-health ratchet for architecture, lint, dependency, flake, defect, documentation, or verification debt. Audit and measurement-only reporting use tailrocks-code-health-audit.

## Invocation

This skill never activates on its own. Name it in your request:

Arguments: `<establish|tighten, approved debt class, metric, and paths>`
